features.title: Print a phone sign-in QR for a trusted HTTPS origin
features.summary: At startup the Host prints one scannable QR per configured HTTPS origin and runs a loopback rewrite proxy so a TLS-terminating tunnel (Tailscale Serve or Funnel) can forward the public authority to the loopback DSH listener without a trustedHosts setting.
failureModes: A non-HTTPS, credentialed, or non-absolute origin is ignored instead of printed.
A busy proxy port is reported on the terminal and leaves the rest of DSH running.
Nothing is printed when the loader or Connection service is unavailable.

verification.testName: rewrites Host and Origin to the loopback authority
